# FatCat Property Management

> Residential property management in Chicago. Tenant placement, maintenance coordination, rent collection, weekly owner reports.

## What it does
- Manages single-family and small multi-unit residential properties
- Weekly owner reports with rent collected, expenses, work orders
- Photo attachments on every report
- Email digest to owner on each new report
- Owner portal: magic-link login (no password), property list, maintenance tickets, annual statements

## For owners
- Marketing: https://fatcatpm.com
- Owner portal: https://portal-fatcatpm.vercel.app
- Owner login: https://portal-fatcatpm.vercel.app (magic link)

## For out-of-state owners
- Partner broker referral program: documented in admin
- Out-of-state property owners get the same portal
- Maintenance ticket system with priority levels

- Parent: https://fatcatam.com (FatCat Asset Management)
